entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: A former planeswalker from Antausia and former Quandrix Junior Professor at Strixhaven who led a secret order of planeswalkers and plotted to steal sparks.

entities.description: Kasmina's home plane.

entities.name: Arcavios

entities.name: Kasmina's order
entities.description: An ancient secret order of planeswalkers led by Kasmina that studied planeswalker spark for centuries.

entities.name: Kasmina's owls

events.summary: Kasmina is lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon and trapped there by Bolas's Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Kasmina was lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon

events.summary: Kasmina fights the Eternals of the Dreadhorde, pulling one to her side with control magic.
events.quote: The skillful use of control magic allowed Kasmina to temporarily pull an Eternal to her side

events.summary: Kasmina invites Rowan and Will Kenrith to study at Strixhaven and guides them to campus.
events.quote: Kasmina went to Kylem and invited Rowan and Will Kenrith to study at Strixhaven

events.summary: Kasmina confronts Lukka, who realizes she was spying; she wins their battle but retreats when mage hunters arrive.
events.quote: Kasmina winning but being forced to retreat once swarms of mage hunters arrived

events.summary: Kasmina loses her spark in the Desparkening, joins the faculty fully and befriends Liliana Vess.
events.quote: losing her Planeswalker's spark in the Desparkening

events.summary: Kasmina identifies her first five recruits as embers and, with Professor Vess, distributes them among the colleges.
The students notice Kasmina's owls following them; her plan is revealed to force their sparks to ignite and steal them to reignite her own.
events.quote: Her underlying purpose was to force them to ignite under stressful circumstances, and to rob their sparks to reignite her own.

events.summary: The students thwart the plot and Kasmina presumably dies in the final confrontation in the heart of a snarl.
events.quote: This plot was thwarted by the students working together, and Kasmina presumably died in the final confrontation

relations.note: former leader of the secret planeswalker order

a former Quandrix Junior Professor at Strixhaven University on Arcavios
She later confronted Lukka, who figured out she was spying on him.
she fought against the Eternals of Bolas' Dreadhorde

relations.note: accompanied by and sees through her owl familiars
relations.quote: She is always accompanied by a "parliament" of owls from several different planes.
